# ModernTax Compliance Platform

> ModernTax: end-to-end compliance services for commercial and SBA lenders across the deal (screening, IRS transcript verification, Quality of Earnings, closing, post-close monitoring and recovery), plus an API and MCP server for the platforms that serve them. ModernTax verifies businesses and individuals against IRS records. Submit a taxpayer, attach a signed Form 8821 naming ModernTax as designee, and receive IRS transcripts (returns, record of account, wage & income, 941 payroll) as PDFs plus structured JSON: filings with financials, transaction codes, balances, liens and a compliance summary.

The API and customer portal run at https://portal.moderntax.io. This site (moderntax.io) holds the API reference.

## Start here

- [API reference](https://moderntax.io/docs): authentication, ordering, polling, webhooks, errors, rate limits
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://portal.moderntax.io/openapi.json): machine-readable description of the REST API
- [Self-serve sandbox](https://portal.moderntax.io/sandbox): a work email gets an API key immediately against synthetic borrower data; no sales call, no card. Programmatic: `POST https://portal.moderntax.io/api/sandbox/signup` with `{"company": "...", "email": "you@yourcompany.com"}` returns the key once. Not every product is available in the sandbox
- [Security](https://portal.moderntax.io/security): how data and keys are protected; contact security@moderntax.io

## Products

- [Compliance Verification](https://moderntax.io/products/compliance-verification): filed and unfiled years, balances, IRS-of-record figures; pre-filled Form 8821 the taxpayer signs
- [Continuous Monitoring](https://moderntax.io/products/continuous-monitoring): follow-up transcript requests for a missing filing; check schedule, charges and stopping rule are confirmed in the customer's quote before enrollment
- [Employment & Income Verification](https://moderntax.io/products/employment-income-verification): IRS-reported W-2 and 1099 wage and income information; may be incomplete for the current processing year and does not establish current employment
- [Payroll Liability (941) Report](https://moderntax.io/products/payroll-liability-941): Form 941 payroll-tax filings and balances; $30 per entity, per requested tax year; covered quarters confirmed in the quote
- [QoE Screening](https://moderntax.io/products/qoe-screening): screen a transaction for a Quality of Earnings scope discussion under SBA SOP 50 10 8.1 with technical policy updates; does not replace an independent QoE report or Cash Proof
- [QoE Agent](https://moderntax.io/products/qoe-agent): AI-assisted Quality of Earnings analysis built on IRS-of-record data and borrower financials, with human review; not by itself an independent QoE report; scope and pricing on request
- [QoE Full-Service](https://moderntax.io/products/qoe-services): Quality of Earnings engagements run by ModernTax; scope, deliverables, timing and fees agreed before work begins
- [Check Reissue Recovery](https://moderntax.io/products/check-reissue-recovery): review of a tax-check reissue request; scope, fees and follow-up confirmed before work begins; IRS processing and delivery are outside ModernTax's control
- [Partner API & MCP](https://moderntax.io/products/partner-api-mcp): REST, webhooks, structured JSON, cross-reference, MCP server, sandbox
- [All products](https://moderntax.io/products/)

## MCP server

- Endpoint: `https://portal.moderntax.io/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC over POST; protocol versions 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05)
- Auth: the same API key as the REST API, as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`
- Tools: `verify_entity`, `order_transcripts`, `get_order_status`, `get_transcript_data`, `cross_reference`
- A production sandbox key gets the read-only tools (no ordering). To try the full flow, including ordering against a simulated IRS, use a staging key at `https://staging.portal.moderntax.io/api/mcp`. Staging test TINs end in 0001 (clean), 0002 (tax lien), 0003 (balance due), 0004 (latest year unfiled), 0005 (wrong form), 0006–0008 (IRS errors)

## Rules an agent should know

- Every order needs a signed Form 8821 naming ModernTax as designee; without it the order waits and nothing goes to the IRS
- `fiscal_year_end_month` is required for 1120, 1120S and 1065 (12 = calendar year)
- 1040 goes with an SSN; 1065, 1120, 1120S and 941 go with an EIN
- Responses never return a full TIN
